title: A Map of Moths
setting: An attic full of old maps
obstacle: The maps change whenever the attic lamp goes out
outcome: They follow moths to a courtyard garden
premise: Locate their grandmother’s lost garden. The maps change whenever the attic lamp goes out. They follow moths to a courtyard garden.
story: Tali spread the maps across the attic floor. Every time Em switched off the lamp, the streets rearranged themselves. A pale moth settled on a blank corner of the oldest map. Then another landed beside it. Em opened the window, and the moths rose in a loose trail above the rooftops. The sisters followed them through two narrow lanes to a courtyard hidden behind a locked gate. Beyond the bars grew their grandmother's blue irises. Tali touched the rusted latch and smiled.

title: The Empty Seat
setting: A school auditorium before a concert
objective: Persuade Anika to perform her solo
obstacle: Anika fears making a mistake in front of the audience
outcome: She begins the piece after Dev joins her for the opening bars
premise: Persuade Anika to perform her solo. Anika fears making a mistake in front of the audience. She begins the piece after Dev joins her for the opening bars.
story: The auditorium filled with murmurs while Anika stared at the empty piano bench. "I'll miss the first note," she told Dev. He pulled a second chair beside the piano. "Then I'll play the first four bars with you." When the curtain rose, his hands found the opening chords and hers followed. After the fourth bar, Dev lifted his fingers away. Anika kept playing. The next note was not perfect, but it was hers, and the room listened until the final chord faded.

title: The Sandglass Trial
setting: An underground archive with a timed security door
objective: Retrieve evidence before the archive seals permanently
obstacle: The security timer advances whenever the lights flicker
outcome: They photograph the evidence and escape through the maintenance shaft
premise: Retrieve evidence before the archive seals permanently. The security timer advances whenever the lights flicker. They photograph the evidence and escape through the maintenance shaft.
story: Noor found the sealed folder on the lowest shelf. Above the door, the timer showed forty seconds. Pavel pulled the folder free, but the lights flickered and the display jumped to twenty. There was no time to carry the heavy box of documents upstairs. Noor opened the folder and photographed each stamped page while Pavel loosened the grate over a maintenance shaft. The lights blinked again: eight seconds. They slid into the shaft with the photographs saved on Noor's camera. The steel door struck the floor behind them, trapping the paper but not the evidence.

title: The Second Recipe
setting: A small kitchen before a family celebration
obstacle: The original recipe card is stained beyond reading
outcome: They use remembered flavors to make a new version together
premise: Recreate a lost family recipe. The original recipe card is stained beyond reading. They use remembered flavors to make a new version together.
story: Leena held the recipe card toward the window, but the ink had dissolved into brown streaks. Amma smelled the toasted cumin and shook her head. "Your grandfather used more ginger," she said. They started again, tasting each spoonful before adding the next ingredient. Leena wrote down the changes on a clean card while Amma watched the pot. By evening the dish tasted familiar, though neither claimed it was identical to the old one. Leena titled the card Second Recipe and left space beneath it for future notes.
